name: get_neighbors
description: Variable-length neighborhood expansion in the graph (depth default 2, clamped 1..=4, optional temporal filter at `at_time`, post-filter on rel_types/min_confidence).

at_time.description: Optional ISO8601 timestamp for temporal filter (only edges valid at this time)

min_confidence.description: Drop edges with confidence below this (0.0..=1.0, default 0.0)

rel_types.description: Optional filter: only follow these rel_types (e.g. ["controls","owns"])
